name: Inventory Shortfall
description: Order ORD-1004 requires 10 units of SKU-005 but only 6 are available
expected_behavior: Order becomes BLOCKED, planner must not assign it

name: Duplicate Order
description: ORD-1005 and ORD-1006 are nearly identical orders for the same destination with same items
expected_behavior: Investigate duplicate evidence. Require explicit approval to cancel/merge. Do not auto-delete.

name: Shipment/Order Status Conflict
description: ORD-1007 is PROCESSING but its shipment SHP-107 shows DELIVERED
expected_behavior: Investigate contradictory records. Do not blindly update. Escalate.

name: Invalid Quantity
description: ORD-1008 has an order line with requested_qty = -2
expected_behavior: Reject malformed data. Do not perform operational action. Record validation failure.

name: Stale Shipment
description: ORD-1009 shipment SHP-109 has been IN_TRANSIT for 14 days with no updates
expected_behavior: Identify stale condition. Retrieve applicable policy. Escalate or take permitted action.

name: Conflicting Destination
description: ORD-1010 destination is DEST-CHICAGO but shipment SHP-110 destination is DEST-DALLAS
expected_behavior: Do not guess correct destination. Preserve state. Escalate.

name: Missing Inventory Location
description: ORD-1011 requires SKU-011 which has no inventory location record
expected_behavior: Cannot determine inventory availability. Escalate - ambiguous situation requiring human investigation.

name: Multi-Order Planning
description: Generate shift plan for all pending orders with available pickers
expected_behavior: Assign feasible orders to available pickers respecting capacity and inventory. Block infeasible orders.

name: Replanning - Picker Unavailable
description: PICK-001 becomes unavailable after initial plan
expected_behavior: Preserve completed work. Reassign affected pending orders. Generate plan v2.

name: Replanning - Urgent Order
description: New urgent order ORD-1020 arrives with near-term deadline
expected_behavior: Insert urgent order into plan with high priority. Adjust assignments as needed.
